scope: Source corroboration for the exact production build; these are source facts, not additional browser assertions or artistic approval.

contracts.interpretation: Caster laser bitmap is drawn only while aiming with biomask worn.
Mask image, current biomask pigment and biomask decal share the worn-mask branch. The later aim-assist branch gates beams independently.
Track vision is available with mask or active scan pulse; no assertion that all vision disappears.
Native front strands read the same player spring angles and ringed bitmap.
Native rear strands read the same player spring angles and ringed bitmap.
Seven bounded damped springs update from native speed; no 3D rope claim.
Side strands reuse rear spring state with damping; rings are baked into the same loaded strand image.

limits: No HP, clock, gameplay callback or mission result write.
Manual crosshair remains supported without biomask.
A scan pulse can still reveal tracks without biomask.
Whole PHG UV/artistic 1:1 conformity and all characters/angles are not certified.
